programmes.d: A natural disaster threatens the lives of two staffers. The president makes an announcement no one saw coming.
Now running for office for the first time, Kirkman and his nascent campaign stumble out of the gate.
A heated debate over child marriage roils Kirkman's staff; Opioid addiction hits home for Mars.
A political attack on Kirkman puts transgender rights in the spotlight; Aaron weighs a major decision.
Aaron's heritage and a widespread teachers' strike become polarizing issues.
Emotions run high after a despicable news story goes viral. Wells finds a clue pointing to conspiracy.
A dying Guatemalan child in a Texas hospital brings immigration to the fore.
A stray Russian bomber jeopardizes Seattle, Mars crusades against a drug company.
Kirkman mobilizes a frantic hunt for the bioterrorist.
Trailing in the polls, Kirkman weighs forcing the FBI's hand over the bioterrorism plot.
On Election Day, Kirkman turns to his therapist to assuage his conscience about the momentous prior 36 hours.
Tom Kirkman is a lower-level cabinet member who is suddenly appointed President of the United States.
Hours after the attack, President Kirkman steps into his role as Commander-in-Chief in the midst of chaos.
President Kirkman and his staff work to keep a high-level security breach of the White House a secret.
Kirkman learns who is behind the attack and grapples with the prospect of war and brewing domestic troubles.
Kirkman makes the difficult decision of sending Navy SEALs on a mission that will define his presidency.
When shots ring out at The White House, Kirkman’s plans at electing a new Congress are thrown into turmoil.
When an American track-and-field coach heads to Russia, President Kirkman is thrust into a hostage exchange.
On the eve of Voting Day, an unexpected development forces Kirkman to consider cancelling the elections.
When classified government documents are leaked online, President Kirkman searches for the party responsible.
Kirkman fears there could be a traitor when he discovers shocking information connected to the Capitol Bombing
The nation reels from the aftermath of the shooting on the steps of the Capitol.
Tension rises between Aaron and Emily as suspicions loom in the White House.
A journalist shocks the White House when he reveals classified information during a press briefing.
Turmoil in an African country forces President Kirkman to rely on an unlikely ally for help.
As Kirkman releases an agenda, Alex makes a controversial public statement that threatens to derail it.
President Kirkman forms an unlikely alliance in the hopes of passing his first bill.
As President Kirkman struggles to put together a new Supreme Court, FBI Agent Hannah Wells goes undercover.
As Kirkman considers candidates for Vice President, Kimble Hookstraten finds herself embroiled in scandal.
